clusters.pick_reason: 1996 implements a proper Accept-header media-type parser (acceptsMediaType) that splits on ';' params and explicitly excludes entries with q=0, avoiding false positives. 2046's fix uses a plain acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which would also incorrectly match unrelated types like application/vnd.api+json or application/jsonpatch+json and ignores quality-value exclusion (q=0) - a real correctness gap versus 1996's approach.
